comment: Source read at commit 2b2ad81. The size control's tooltip and its behaviour disagree: Hellebore.cpp:58 configures the display as 0.3 * 4^v - 0.3 while line 90 computes 0.3 * 3^v - 0.3, so the tooltip reads up to 0.9 seconds where the delay lines reach 0.6. A third output, TEST_OUTPUT, is declared and configured but has no PortWidget, so no cable can reach it. The time CV attenuverter is configured with a display multiplier of -100 and an offset of 100, so its tooltip reads 100% when the trimpot is centred and doing nothing.
